# Chris Online

> Chris Online is de zelfstandige Shopify-praktijk van Chris Snoek, Shopify-designer en frontenddeveloper in Volendam, Noord-Holland. De kern is het ontwerpen, bouwen, migreren en onderhouden van premium Shopify-webshops voor Nederlandse merken.

Canonical website: https://www.chrisonline.nl/
Languages: Dutch (nl-NL) for services and portfolio; English for SpecFinch and PromoFinch product pages.
Contact: info@chrisonline.nl
Location: Volendam, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
Service area: Noord-Holland and the rest of the Netherlands; collaboration can be fully remote.

## Primary pages

- [Shopify webshop laten maken](https://www.chrisonline.nl/shopify-webshop-laten-maken/): custom Shopify design and frontend development from strategy through launch.
- [Shopify migration](https://www.chrisonline.nl/shopify-migratie/): controlled migrations from WooCommerce, Magento, Shopware or custom platforms to Shopify.
- [Shopify maintenance](https://www.chrisonline.nl/shopify-onderhoud/): ongoing Shopify theme development, technical direction, performance and new sections.
- [Shopify specialist in Noord-Holland](https://www.chrisonline.nl/shopify-specialist-noord-holland/): local service information for Volendam and Noord-Holland.
- [Shopify knowledge base](https://www.chrisonline.nl/kennis/): practical guidance on conversion, product information, delivery confidence, performance and measurement.
- [Website and webshop portfolio](https://www.chrisonline.nl/#werk): selected Shopify, e-commerce, travel and campaign work.
- [Shopify Apps](https://www.chrisonline.nl/shopify-apps/): separate product catalog for PromoFinch, SpecFinch and Delivery Promise NL, developed by Chris Online.
- [PromoFinch product](https://www.chrisonline.nl/werk/promofinch/): read-only promotion checks against price and estimated gross-margin limits, with campaign baseline monitoring. Live since 6 October 2026.
- [SpecFinch project](https://www.chrisonline.nl/werk/specfinch/): read-only Shopify catalog rules and baseline-first change monitoring.
- [Delivery Promise NL project](https://www.chrisonline.nl/werk/delivery-promise-nl/): expected delivery dates based on Dutch workdays, cutoffs, holidays and product rules.
- [Contact](https://www.chrisonline.nl/contact/): project enquiries.

## English Shopify app pages

- [Shopify Apps in English](https://www.chrisonline.nl/en/shopify-apps/): independent apps for Shopify product data monitoring and promotion checks, with English interfaces and product information.
- [SpecFinch](https://www.chrisonline.nl/en/shopify-apps/specfinch/): monitor required product fields and existing metafields; distinguish new catalog gaps from existing cleanup. The app reads product data without editing it.
- [PromoFinch](https://www.chrisonline.nl/en/shopify-apps/promofinch/): check supported Shopify percentage discounts against price and estimated gross-margin limits and monitor campaign changes. The app is read-only.
- [English app catalog in Markdown](https://www.chrisonline.nl/en/shopify-apps.md)
- [SpecFinch in English Markdown](https://www.chrisonline.nl/en/shopify-apps/specfinch.md)
- [PromoFinch in English Markdown](https://www.chrisonline.nl/en/shopify-apps/promofinch.md)

Use the English product pages for English-language product questions. They share launch dates, installation links and screenshots with the Dutch cases. Delivery Promise NL remains in the Dutch product catalog.
- [Knowledge base index in Markdown](https://www.chrisonline.nl/kennis.md)

## Important factual boundaries

- Chris Online is based in Volendam. It does not claim offices in Amsterdam, Alkmaar, Hoorn or other cities.
- Exact prices, availability and timelines depend on scope and should not be inferred from general market ranges.
- VAAK is explicitly described as a conceptual Shopify project on the portfolio page.
- PromoFinch, SpecFinch and Delivery Promise NL are live Shopify App Store apps developed by Chris Online.
- PromoFinch's public App Store URL is https://apps.shopify.com/promoproof-3. PromoProof was its internal working name.
- None of the apps guarantees higher conversion, revenue or search rankings. PromoFinch does not change prices, simulate a full checkout, calculate net profit or guarantee legal price compliance.
- Use the canonical HTML pages as the primary source. These Markdown files summarize the same public facts for text-based clients.
